title: Bound the two real Worker restart test bodies explicitly
summary: Linux CI failed the missing-policy restart test at Vitest’s implicit five-second deadline. Its assertions and requests are unchanged; the body now has a bounded sixty-second deadline. The adjacent durability restart body gets the same deadline after tracing the sibling path; it passed the cited CI run and is not another reproduced failure. Hooks, schema-upgrade deadline, retries, runtime and domain performance budgets are unchanged.
proves: pnpm exec vitest run --root packages/logbook --maxWorkers=1 passes all 25 logbook tests once. Targeted logbook lint/typecheck pass. Only the two body deadlines change in test code. The actual failed Linux job is retained, and no owned test services remain.

captions.01-linux-ci-failure: Actual Linux CI job log: the missing-policy case hit its implicit 5000 ms deadline; the durability sibling and all 24 other logbook tests passed.
captions.02-real-logbook-suite: The full serial real logbook suite passes once with explicit restart-body deadlines.
captions.03-static-checks: Targeted logbook lint and type checking pass.
captions.04-cleanup: The private logbook test ports and owned issuer/Worker processes are closed.
captions.05-test-only-diff: The actual test diff changes only the two explicit body deadlines.
